---

## Who We Are

100Bold is a growth agency for established Texas service businesses and founders. We are operators who have built and run businesses in the exact industries we serve: real estate development, general contracting, construction materials, local services, and technology.

We are not a traditional marketing agency. We know margin pressure, subcontractor relationships, BD cycles, and client expectations because we have managed them ourselves.

We only work in industries our founding team has operated in. We know your pain points because we've lived them.

---

## What We Do

### Google Domination
Full Google Business Profile takeover — optimization, weekly content, review generation, and local SEO. We treat your Google Business Profile like an active marketing channel. Every field optimized, weekly content posted, every review replied to with keyword-rich responses. Monthly performance heat map showing local search position over time. AI chatbot installed on website for 24/7 lead capture.

### LinkedIn CEO Authority
Complete LinkedIn profile management for CEOs and founders. Strategy, ghostwriting, engagement, and network growth — fully hands-off. We manage multiple CEO profiles across complementary industries. Cross-amplification accelerates growth for every account.

### Social Media Content
High-converting content across Meta, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and more. Reviews transformed into short-form video, carousels, infographics, and written posts. Content goes up on schedule — no approval delays.

### Paid Ads
Google and Meta ad campaigns layered on established organic foundation. We only recommend ads once organic ranking is solid — organic ranking reduces cost-per-click significantly.

## MinAI — The Engine Behind 100Bold

MinAI (minai.biz) is 100Bold's sister company and the technology infrastructure behind every client engagement. Founder-built platform, scaled to 1,000,000+ users.

Every 100Bold client gets MinAI from day one. No extra cost.

- **AI Chatbot** — Installed on website and socials. Trained on client's business data. Qualifies leads & books appointments 24/7.
- **Voice AI Receptionist** — Answers inbound calls automatically. Handles lead qualification. Works at 4 AM on weekends.
- **5-Star Review Funnel** — Automated SMS + email sequences that request reviews from past customers on autopilot.
- **CRM + Unified Inbox** — All leads from web, phone, and social flow into one place. Nothing falls through the cracks.
- **Database Reactivation** — Re-engage dormant past clients sitting on thousands of untouched contacts.
